description: This file defines the ExecutorSource class in Apache Spark, which collects and exposes various executor metrics such as thread pool stats, file system stats, and task metrics using Dropwizard metrics system.

classes.name: ExecutorSource
classes.description: A class that collects and exposes executor metrics such as thread pool activity, file system statistics, and task counters for monitoring purposes.

methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a given file system scheme.
